resultats.q: How do I set up online payments so my clients can pay their invoices by card?
resultats.reponse: Once that's set up, your clients can pay directly online by card or PayPal from the link on their invoice, and Lume automatically matches the payment to the invoice — no manual entry needed on your end. You'll find the setup under Finances, in the Payments tab. Want me to send a payment link on a specific invoice once a client is ready to pay?

resultats.q: Can my technicians see invoice amounts in Lume, and where do I change that?
resultats.reponse:
By default technicians don't see pricing — it's controlled under Settings → Roles & Permissions. There's a financial visibility toggle (pricing) you can turn on or off per role, or even per individual member if you want an exception for just one tech.

Want me to turn it on or off for the technician role, or for a specific person?

resultats.q: Where do I set the days and hours my crews can be booked?
resultats.reponse: You can set that under each crew's weekly availability windows in Lume — pick the team, then define which weekdays and hours it can be booked (or reset to the default Mon–Fri 8 AM–5 PM). Want me to check or update a specific crew's hours?
